title: Heading to the Asahi Hai FS

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Days of training continued in preparation for the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Complementing her training at Tracen Academy, the days spent honing herself at the Ibaramine Training Center were steadily elevating her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: All is well—in fact, her rate of growth has exceeded our projections.
choice_data_list: 万全の状態で『朝日杯FS』に挑めましょう

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
With this, we shall surely fulfill our long-cherished wish.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Being able to complete the cutting-edge training at the Baramine Training Center made an enormous difference.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(By applying the insights gained there to my daily
training at Tracen Academy as well...
I was able to hone my abilities with far greater efficiency.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(This outcome is solely thanks to the Trainer's dedication
in securing that spot for us.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(That is not all. From early morning until late at night,
they work ever harder toward securing victory in the Asahi Hai FS.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Everything within our power has been done.
The tide, the momentum—all leans in our favor.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The victory that everyone in my clan has yearned for—
Next time, I shall surely achieve it—!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (What if, even after all this, I still fall short?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... Coward. To harbor fear in the face of our dearest wish...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We cannot afford complacency.
Let us continue honing ourselves without pause.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must break the curse of thorns.
And bring everlasting peace to my clan—without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Now I'm wide awake.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(If I am in the lobby, I should at least be able
to review the video records
of the contenders in the Asahi Hai FS—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: ……お疲れでいらっしゃいますか？

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, I am fine.
I merely had a bit of trouble falling asleep last night.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Forgive me.
I caused you to worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shaking my head, I brewed some relaxing herbal tea for the time being. Depending on how things go, I may need to adjust her menu.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Mother...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: "An encouragement rally ahead of the Asahi Hai FS, is it?"

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, representatives from the Cultural and Sports Foundation,
who have long supported our clan,
personally reached out to me.”

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'As a foundation supporting promising young athletes,
we would like to inquire if we might host a gathering to celebrate and encourage your endeavors.'"

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'Since the GⅠ is right around the corner, I plan to decline.
The other party also said not to push it.
However, I thought I should confirm your wishes just in case.'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Thank you for informing me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(It is a foundation with long-standing ties to my clan.
To be sure, this is a hectic period, but—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I would be truly grateful if you would consider holding the event.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'...!
Oh my, truly—?'"

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'...If that is what you wish, then so be it.
However, at this point in time—
are you truly not pushing yourself too hard?'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"The Asahi Hai FS will be a momentous race.
I must greet everyone who has supported me thus far, and offer them my gratitude and resolve."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the weekend. Despite how abruptly it had been organized,
numerous individuals tied to the Rose Clan gathered for the rally.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I offer my heartfelt gratitude
for organizing such an occasion today.

text_block_list.name: Foundation Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: Likewise, I truly thank you for gracing us with your presence despite your busy schedule.

text_block_list.name: Foundation Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
...I have stood with the clan across many years.
If this pep rally serves in any way to raise Lady Rose's spirits,
nothing could bring me greater joy.

text_block_list.name: Foundation Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
I quietly pray that the Asahi Hai FS
will be a race without regrets.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Without fail, I shall deliver a G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (The Foundation President was a central figure in developing the Baramine Training Center... Despite virtually no prospect of profit, they devoted their utmost efforts for our clan's sake.)

text_block_list.name: Supporters' Association President
text_block_list.text:
May all those tearful days finally be rewarded...!
*Sniff!* I offer you my deepest prayers~!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much.
Everyone's support serves as our encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The president of the fan club single-handedly manages its operations,
spreading the name of our clan through various events
and fostering unity among our supporters.)

text_block_list.name: Prestigious Clan Representative
text_block_list.text:
Because it is us, there is a crown only we can grasp.
A future that will open up beyond it.
...Do your best.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will give it everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (You arranged numerous exhibition races with members of the Rose clan for me. Bearing the weight of the family, I had so much to learn from them.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to make this bold declaration:
if anyone can achieve it, it is 'Rose Kingdom'!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(He previously put together a special feature on my clan,
hoping that more people might take an interest
in our cherished dream—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(With the aid of many hands,
my clan strides ever forward toward our long-cherished dream.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(And now, hoping that Rose Kingdom can deliver,
they have entrusted me with their expectations—faint, yet unmistakable.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... I must accomplish it.
I must fulfill our long-cherished ambition.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I shall do so, by any and all means...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—Why hesitate now?! Do not fear.
If I am to become the king who shoulders the future...!)

text_block_list.name: Foundation Staff
text_block_list.text:
And now, to conclude, Lady Rose Kingdom, who embarks
upon the challenge to fulfill our long-cherished dream,
will share a few words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing the tension in her shoulders as she headed for the podium,
I found myself raising a hand in a small wave before I realized it.
choice_data_list: ――僭越ながら、まず私からお話ししても？

text_block_list.name: Foundation Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah—Trainer <username>.
Yes, certainly. I do not mind at all; please, go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside Rose Kingdom,
I bowed toward the murmuring crowd.
choice_data_list: ローズ様は、必ず悲願を達成なさるお方です

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The words spilled from my lips without a moment's hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wherever Rose Kingdom looked, always—
always, the Rose Clan was there in her sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strength stemming from her ever-present devotion to her clan,
and her prayers for their eternal prosperity――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She is an Umamusume talented enough to achieve a GⅠ victory entirely on her own. Yet, even if that were true—
choice_data_list: 私はともに、呪縛を断ちたい

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To serve as her right hand and achieve our long-cherished dream.
There could be no greater honor than that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Delivering the words in a single breath, she bowed—
Before she knew it, the stir in the hall had only grown louder.

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text:
“My, what a reliable Trainer.”
“I hear even top-tier Trainers recognize their brilliance.”

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text:
"'—Indeed, victory is something seized by the two of you together.'
'We are cheering for you, Lady Rose, Trainer!'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――
...Heh... haha!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: No—it's just...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Forgetting that someone as courageous as you stood by my side... what was I ever so afraid of, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my abilities have grown distinctly.
Securing permission to use the Ibaramine Training Center
was also your doing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I was not challenging this alone.
Never alone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You... You, who told me you wished to break this curse together—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad to be your Trainer.
choice_data_list: ともに、勝利を追わせてください

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Naturally, were it not for you.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "The Asahi Hai FS—! The center of attention is surely Rose Kingdom of the House of Roses!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Yes. Despite claiming numerous graded stakes, the Rose clan has yet to reach a GⅠ title. A victory today would fulfill a long-cherished dream. Expectations are soaring.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“They say expectations are sky-high.” “For her?”
“If she wins today, that'd be incredible.”
“You can do it, Rose King!” “Make our dream come true—!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: My beloved Rose clan!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Today shall become the most monumental day
in my clan's history.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The curse of thorns is broken,
and here and now, the Kingdom of Roses cries its first breath!

text_block_list.name: The Rose Clan
text_block_list.text:
“Lady Roseee!!” “We pray for your victory!”
“Please fulfill the long-cherished wish—the future of our clan rests in your hands!!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Come, let us go, Trainer...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This is the dawn of our glory—!
